_comment: The pins on the home page's network map, taken from the owner's image (docs/public/triplebit-map.webp) by tools/make-map.mjs. x and y are the pin's tip in the map's grid units (viewBox 0 0 200 99). kind is core (Core Location), edge (Edge Location) or soon (Coming Soon). links join core pins by their id with a dashed line whose dashes flow from the first pin to the second; the three run in a loop: lower US, Europe, upper US, back to lower US. The places are not named here because the image does not name them.
